name: Conlet Plastics Inc
old_description: Located in New Milford, we have over 40 years of combined experience with plastic thermoforming & molding. Our product range includes heavy gauge forming, plastic covers, plastic housings, CNC routing, CNC milling, die cutting, in-house tooling, prototypes and long and short product runs.
about:
Conlet Plastics Inc operates from New Milford, Connecticut, where it has built over 40 years of combined experience in plastic thermoforming and molding. The company was established to provide custom-formed plastic components and has remained a local, independently owned shop.

Its capabilities span heavy-gauge thermoforming, plastic covers and housings, CNC routing and milling, die cutting, and in-house tooling using wood, epoxy, or aluminum molds. The facility runs prototypes through production volumes of 1 to 100,000 parts, with assembly and packaging areas that allow multiple projects to run concurrently. A team of approximately eight employees handles all stages from tooling to final delivery.

Conlet Plastics functions as a specialized extension of its clients' facilities, serving customers who need cost-conscious review and on-time delivery for custom plastic parts. While specific industries are not listed, the company's output includes enclosures, covers, and formed components for a range of industrial and commercial applications.

The company emphasizes its convenient location on Pickett District Road, with quick access to Route 7 and Interstate 84, and highlights in-house mold making as a way to control lead times and quality. Every project receives careful review to forestall production problems, aiming for an optimum balance of price, quality, and schedule.
